summary: E2E tested newsletter discount popup + abandoned-cart tracking on Sculptiva. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (source-based codes SCULPTIVA15/10, duplicate returns existing, invalid email 422, cart/track upsert, cart/converted flag, Mongo doc shape). Frontend Playwright: popup appears at ~8s, closes via X, sets sculptiva_popup_seen, does not reappear after reload, reappears after localStorage.clear, email submit returns SCULPTIVA15 with tap-to-copy code, sets sculptiva_email, popup suppressed when sculptiva_email present, add-to-cart triggers debounced /api/cart/track (Mongo abandoned_carts doc verified with items/size/colour/reminder_sent=false/converted=false), /api/cart/converted flips converted:true. Backend worker running with SENDGRID_API_KEY empty — no 'Abandoned cart worker error' in logs.

issues: Missing DialogTitle/aria-describedby — accessibility warnings in console (pre-existing, unrelated to this feature)
React warning: Invalid DOM property fetchpriority (should be fetchPriority) — pre-existing

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: newsletter duplicate returns EXISTING code regardless of new source — verified as intended (popup email later submitted via footer still returns SCULPTIVA15).
abandoned_cart_worker guards on SENDGRID_API_KEY + SENDER_EMAIL — correctly dormant. Loop still runs every 5min without hitting DB when key empty.
CartContext debounces trackCart at 2s; email required in localStorage before syncing — correct.
cart/converted returns ok:true even when email unknown (no upsert side-effect since $set on non-existent doc doesn't create) — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Test emails prefixed test_<uuid>@example.com and pw_test_<ts>@example.com in newsletter_subscribers and abandoned_carts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature fully working end-to-end. SENDGRID_API_KEY still empty (worker dormant by design). Preview URL: https://sculpt-confidence-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Popup 8s timer; use fresh browser context or localStorage.clear() before retesting.
